model: ln M(t) = ln L + (ln M0 - ln L) * phi^t, with t in years from the snapshot
multipleDefinition: circulating market cap (CoinMarketCap daily quote, summed over legacy+new token for migrations) / trailing-365-day DefiLlama revenue, sampled at calendar month-ends 2018-12..2026-10

bear.basis: L = protocol panel long-run mean exp(a/(1-b)); phi = December-only (non-overlapping) protocol AR(1), fastest point estimate

base.basis: L = protocol cross-section median 2026-10; phi = pre-registered primary protocol AR(1)

bull.basis: L = protocol cross-section upper quartile 2026-10; phi = protocol AR(1) relative to date mean (slower, cycle-neutral fade)

maximum.basis: L = protocol upper quartile; phi = upper 95% bound of cycle-neutral protocol AR(1) (slowest fade the protocol data do not reject)

consistency.twoStage: Years of 30% annual receipt growth needed after the exit to justify the multiple at a 15% mature required return and 3% stable growth.

sources.label: Damodaran, Investment Valuation, ch. 12
sources.finding: Terminal multiples taken from comparable firms mix relative and discounted cash-flow valuation; a stable-growth model is the consistent alternative.

sources.label: Chan, Karceski and Lakonishok (2003)
sources.finding: No persistence in long-term earnings growth beyond chance; a multiple of 100 falling to 20 over ten years needs about 29% annual growth, near the 95th percentile.

sources.label: Fama and French (2000)
sources.finding: Profitability mean-reverts at about 38% a year.

limitations: The panel covers 2020-2026, about one and a half crypto cycles; three-year outcomes rest on few protocols.
Only protocols still listed today are included.
Part of the reversion is mechanical: noise in the revenue denominator pulls extreme multiples back.
Raw market-cap and revenue files are not redistributed; analysis/multiple-fade/raw_sha256.json lists the hash of each file that analysis/multiple-fade/run_all.sh downloads.
